title: One Texas Cave Holds 15 Million Bats That Eat 100 Tons a Night

scenes.text: One cave in Texas holds more mammals than anywhere else on Earth.
It's Bracken Cave, home to fifteen to twenty million Mexican free-tailed bats.
Every evening they pour out in waves that last almost four hours.
Then they hunt, and eat around a hundred tons of insects in a single night.
Beetles, winged ants and moths, all gone before sunrise.
Fifteen million mouths, one cave, and a hundred tons of dinner.

description:
Bracken Cave in Texas is home to 15 to 20 million Mexican free-tailed bats, one of the densest gatherings of mammals on Earth.
They eat roughly 100 tons of insects in a night.
Would you watch them leave?
first_comment: Would you stand and watch four hours of bats leave a cave?
